title: Three LiDARs, Twenty-Five Datasets: Cross-Source Generalization in Tree-Species Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.22606v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: FOR-species20K is the largest public LiDAR benchmark for tree-species classification, pooling 25 independently collected terrestrial, mobile, and airborne laser-scanning datasets across 33 species. We introduce a multi-resolution, multi-view ConvNeXtV2 model that improves official hidden-test accuracy from 79.5% to 85.0%, ranking first at the time of submission. We then examine what this score measures. Because the hidden test is species-balanced, its overall accuracy is more comparable to a macro metric than to accuracy under the public set's long-tailed distribution. Moreover, the official random split places every source dataset in both training and evaluation. A logistic probe recovers source identity from out-of-fold model probabilities with 69% accuracy, while geometric features identify the source above 90% within two widely shared species; 18 of the 33 species occur in only one source. translated_title: 三个激光雷达，二十五个数据集：树种识别中的跨源泛化
translated_abstract: FOR-species20K是目前最大的公开LiDAR树种分类基准，汇集了25个独立采集的地面、移动和机载激光扫描数据集，涵盖33个树种。我们提出了一种多分辨率、多视角的ConvNeXtV2模型，将官方隐藏测试集的准确率从79.5%提升至85.0%，在提交时排名第一。随后我们深入考察了这一分数究竟衡量了什么。由于隐藏测试集在物种层面是均衡的，其总体准确率更接近于宏平均指标，而非公开数据集长尾分布下的准确率。此外，官方的随机数据划分将每个源数据集同时纳入训练集和评估集。逻辑回归探针能够以69%的准确率从折外模型概率中恢复出样本的数据源身份，而仅凭几何特征就能在两个广泛分布的共享物种中以超过90%的准确率识别数据来源；33个物种中有18个仅出现在单一数据源中。在源-物种-单元留出评估下，评估……
tldr: 本文提出了在FOR-species20K树种分类基准上排名第一的多分辨率多视角ConvNeXtV2模型（准确率85.0%），并揭示了官方随机划分存在数据源泄漏问题——物种均衡的隐藏测试掩盖了长尾分布和跨数据源泛化的真实挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a top-ranked multi-resolution, multi-view ConvNeXtV2 model (85.0% accuracy) on the FOR-species20K tree-species benchmark, and reveals that its official random split leaks source identity, with the species-balanced hidden test masking the true challenges of long-tailed distribution and cross-source generalization.
